title: Reward-Driven Collider Physics Challenges for Self-Improving Agentic AI via Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.15885v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in agentic AI have demonstrated the potential to automate complex high-energy physics (HEP) workflows. We focus on the regime of HEP tasks where frontier models still struggle to provide correct and complete solutions, and introduce an open-ended optimization task format with continuous, automatically evaluated rewards. Unlike conventional benchmarks focused on task completion, these tasks target reinforcement learning (RL) environments to generate agentic improvement on state- of-the-art HEP challenges. We benchmark frontier reasoning models on several HEP tasks and demonstrate an initial proof of concept in which a small language model improves through RL using automated feedback without human intervention. translated_title: 基于强化学习的奖励驱动对撞机物理挑战：面向自我改进的智能体AI
translated_abstract: 智能体AI的最新进展展示了自动化复杂高能物理（HEP）工作流程的潜力。我们专注于前沿模型仍难以提供正确且完整解决方案的HEP任务领域，引入了一种开放式的优化任务格式，其奖励是连续的且可自动评估。与专注于任务完成度的传统基准测试不同，这些任务面向强化学习（RL）环境，旨在让智能体在最先进的高能物理挑战上获得改进。我们在多个HEP任务上对前沿推理模型进行了基准测试，并展示了一个初步的概念验证：一个小型语言模型通过强化学习和自动化反馈，在无需人工干预的情况下实现了自我改进。通过将具有挑战性的高能物理问题与可验证的科学奖励和强化学习相结合，我们旨在推动智能体AI从复现既有工作流程走向自主发现更优的科学解决方案，为此铺平道路。
tldr: 该论文提出一种具有连续自动评估奖励的开放式对撞机物理优化任务格式，并首次证明小型语言模型可通过强化学习与自动化反馈在无需人工干预的情况下自我改进，攻克前沿推理模型难以解决的高能物理挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces open-ended collider physics optimization tasks with continuous, automatically evaluated rewards, and provides a proof of concept that a small language model can self-improve through reinforcement learning with automated feedback, tackling high-energy physics challenges that frontier models still struggle to solve.
